assignment: Independent random native assignment, retained before the choice page; no URL assignment and no quota balancing.
placement: Concept is the fixed physical slot: 1–3 top shelf left to right; 4–6 bottom shelf left to right. Product rotates through all six positions across versions.
availability: Versions 1–4 offer all products; version 5 retains p103 on the shelf but unavailable; version 6 retains p106 but unavailable.

schema.Product: Stable product code (101–106); ID is p followed by this code
schema.Price: Displayed price in integer USD cents
schema.Available: 1 selectable, 0 unavailable and excluded from native choices

statistical_status: Illustrative controlled permutations; not statistically optimized or validated conjoint.
